# Flamingo Supermarket

> Family-owned international supermarket and food hall in Cooper City, Florida (Embassy Lakes Shopping Center, 2581 N Hiatus Rd, Cooper City, FL 33026). Family in the grocery business since 1973; this store opened June 2025. Open every day 7 AM – 10 PM. Phone (954) 228-0435. Email flamingosupermarkets@gmail.com.

## What it is
- Full supermarket: fresh produce, full-service butcher and seafood counter, bakery, kosher aisle, and products from 17+ countries (Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, Peru, Mexico, Dominican Republic, Argentina, Uruguay, Brazil, Chile, Caribbean, Middle East, Asia).
- Six restaurants/kitchens open daily inside the store ("eatery" / food hall): La Casita de los Ñaños (Ecuadorian: encebollado, bolón, tigrillo, seco de chivo, hornado, guatita, ceviche; breakfast special 8–11 AM $10.99), Taco Way Taqueria (al pastor, carne asada, birria; daily 12:30–9 PM), Papi Pollo & Don Chicharrón (fried chicken: 2-piece & fries, 8-piece box; chicharrón by the pound), Flamingo Picantería (evening grill Mon–Fri 4–9 PM: pinchos, churrasco, salchipapa, chaulafán), Panadería Ambato / D'Ambato Bakery (Ecuadorian bread, guaguas de pan, colada morada in season, cakes to order, daily from 7 AM), Cane Cartel Juice Bar (sugar cane juice, batidos, coffee; daily 9 AM–7 PM).
- Flamingo Bar & Grill: coming soon in the back next to Taco Way — table seating, drinks, games on big screens.
- Live music throughout the store every Saturday and Sunday.
- Catering: office lunches, party trays, holiday packages, custom cakes. Call (954) 228-0435.
- Online ordering: 330+ products for pickup, local delivery in Cooper City, or shipping anywhere in the USA — https://flamingo-supermarkets.myshopify.com
- Weekly sale ad every Wednesday; a weekly recipe built from sale items.
- Serves Cooper City, Pembroke Pines, Davie, Weston, Miramar, Hollywood and Southwest Ranches.
